purpose: ML method feasibility inventory; recommendations are not implemented metrics or performance claims. Existing primary/ML/decision families remain frozen.
data_contract: Batch identity is known; acceptable/defective outcome labels, independent phase/instance truth and specimen independence are unavailable. Sites remain n.

candidates.label: Fixed bright-object graph / spatial descriptors
candidates.reason: Measures arrangement beyond per-object sizes without fitting neural weights.
candidates.gate: Expert component/crop review; deterministic topology and object-floor sensitivity; site statistics; loading/size and acquisition controls; no electrical-connectivity interpretation.

candidates.label: Equal-site frozen-encoder novelty audit
candidates.reason: Reuses current cached DINOv2 representations; audits unequal patch contributions and nuisance sensitivity.
candidates.gate: Equal site influence in fitting/memory and evaluation; fold-local PCA; nearest-reference evidence; acquisition-only and geometry baselines; abstention for unavailable quality.

candidates.label: Fixed convolution / Gabor texture comparator
candidates.reason: Simple, interpretable filtering may expose directional texture without training a CNN.
candidates.gate: Bounded prespecified bank; redundancy with existing FFT/tensors; acquisition perturbations; no graphite-plate or transport claim.

candidates.label: Train a CNN classifier
candidates.reason: Batch membership can support two-sample tests, but is not a defect label; neural complexity has no demonstrated advantage on these sites.
candidates.gate: More independent specimens and task-valid labels; grouped validation with specimen/session controls; frozen evaluation protocol.

candidates.label: Train a GNN
candidates.reason: Many nodes do not create more independent graphs; current object identity and edge meaning are unvalidated.
candidates.gate: Validated nodes/edges and task labels; sufficient independent graphs; ablation must beat deterministic graph and node-only baselines.

candidates.label: Supervised CNN / U-Net phase-instance segmentation
candidates.reason: Can target measurement quality after the independent ROI benchmark is annotated.
candidates.gate: Independent phase/instance labels, uncertain pixels and abstentions; held-out sites/specimens; report KPI error as well as segmentation overlap.

candidates.label: Train a self-supervised image/graph encoder
candidates.reason: No quality labels required for pretraining, but correlated known-site images and nuisance-preserving augmentations can encode acquisition.
candidates.gate: External independent microscopy evidence or stronger known-data validation; scientifically valid augmentations; controls and fixed unseen protocol.

candidates.label: Deep reconstruction / one-class density methods
candidates.reason: Working reference contains anomalies; reconstruction/density scores need clean calibration and interpretable controls.
candidates.gate: Reviewed reference scope, independent calibration sites, low-dimensional/simple baseline, honest finite-sample and exchangeability limits.

guardrails: No current model training or new numerical performance measurements.
No change to primary KPIs, material classifier inputs, thresholds or verdicts.
All reference-dependent preprocessing/model selection inside site/specimen folds and permutations.
Do not tune on unseen data and still call it independent validation.
Agreement between methods on the same images is not independent confirmation.
